move: cards deal in, front card swipes off and tucks behind, lock pops
how: A phone mockup rises in (y 60, rotateX 8, expo.out) beside a headline while a blue glow drifts x -40 to 40. Three stacked cards deal in from x 340 with rotate 8 and a from-end stagger (expo.out) from 9%; dots, action buttons and transactions follow with power3.out staggers. At 42% the front card flies left (x -360, rotate -10, power3.in), the two behind rise to the front with back.out(1.5), then the flown card returns behind at the back scale (.88) with expo.out and the page dot switches. At 69% the Freeze action presses (scale .85 yoyo) and the middle card desaturates via filter while a white lock badge pops with back.out(2.5). Phone and copy exit at 90%.
adapt: Replace card numbers, balances, bank name, transactions and the three card gradients; keep the deal-in stagger and the swipe/tuck sequence timings.
port: mount(el, shot) renders phone, cards and rows from shot.cards; animate returns the timeline with deal at 0.09D, swipe at 0.42D, freeze at 0.69D. The zIndex set() on the tucked card and the filter tween port directly; scope selectors to el.
caveats: uses filter: saturate/brightness on a card, cheap at this size
